tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

content.content:
"""Edit Decision List: the single contract between the planner (Claude) and the renderer.

See docs/EDL.md for the full spec. Key ideas:
  * `segments` are the main timeline, played back to back. Output time is cumulative.
  * Everything else (overlays, sfx, music, text, bleeps) is anchored either in OUTPUT time (`at`)
    or in SOURCE time (`src_at`, seconds into the raw gameplay recording). The planner reads the
    transcript in source time, so `src_at` is the natural anchor; the compiler maps it through the cut list.
  * An event whose `src_at` falls inside footage that was cut away is dropped with a warning.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

SEGMENT_TYPES = {"source", "cutaway", "card"}
OVERLAY_TYPES = {"greenscreen", "video", "image", "motion", "transition"}


class EDLError(ValueError):
    pass


@dataclass
class Span:
    """A piece of source footage placed on the output timeline."""
    seg_index: int
    out_start: float
    out_end: float
    src_in: float | None   # None for cutaways/cards (no source mapping)
    speed: float = 1.0
    seg_id: str | None = None

    def src_to_out(self, t: float) -> float | None:
        if self.src_in is None:
            return None
        src_out = self.src_in + (self.out_end - self.out_start) * self.speed
        if self.src_in - 1e-6 <= t <= src_out + 1e-6:
            return self.out_start + (t - self.src_in) / self.speed
        return None


def seg_duration(seg: dict, asset_lookup=None) -> float:
    t = seg.get("type", "source")
    if t == "source":
        d = (seg["out"] - seg["in"]) / seg.get("speed", 1.0)
    elif t == "cutaway":
        if "out" in seg:
            d = seg["out"] - seg.get("in", 0.0)
        else:
            a = asset_lookup(seg["asset"]) if asset_lookup else None
            if not a:
                raise EDLError(f"cutaway {seg.get('id')} needs 'out' (asset duration unknown)")
            d = (a.get("use_out") or a["duration_s"]) - seg.get("in", a.get("use_in") or 0.0)
    elif t == "card":
        if "dur" in seg:
            d = seg["dur"]
        else:                                   # motion-template card: the template's own length
            from .paths import STUDIO
            tj = STUDIO / "motion" / "templates" / seg.get("template", "") / "template.json"
            d = float(json.loads(tj.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("duration", 2.0)) if tj.exists() else 2.0
    else:
        raise EDLError(f"unknown segment type {t!r}")
    return d + seg.get("freeze_end", 0.0)


def build_spans(edl: dict, asset_lookup=None) -> list[Span]:
    spans, t = [], 0.0
    for i, seg in enumerate(edl["segments"]):
        d = seg_duration(seg, asset_lookup)
        if d <= 0:
            raise EDLError(f"segment {i} ({seg.get('id')}) has non-positive duration")
        src_in = seg["in"] if seg.get("type", "source") == "source" else None
        live = d - seg.get("freeze_end", 0.0)
        spans.append(Span(i, t, t + live, src_in, seg.get("speed", 1.0), seg.get("id")))
        t += d
    return spans


def total_duration(edl: dict, asset_lookup=None) -> float:
    return sum(seg_duration(s, asset_lookup) for s in edl["segments"])


def src_to_out(spans: list[Span], t: float) -> float | None:
    for sp in spans:
        o = sp.src_to_out(t)
        if o is not None:
            return o
    return None


def resolve_time(ev: dict, spans: list[Span], warnings: list[str], label: str) -> float | None:
    if "seg" in ev:
        # segment-anchored: unambiguous even when the same footage appears twice (cold opens),
        # and it travels with the segment when shorts are cut from the main edit
        sp = next((x for x in spans if x.seg_id == ev["seg"]), None)
        if sp is None:
            warnings.append(f"{label}: segment {ev['seg']!r} not in this edit - dropped")
            return None
        if "rel" in ev:
            return sp.out_start + float(ev["rel"])
        if "src_at" in ev and sp.src_in is not None:
            o = sp.src_to_out(float(ev["src_at"]))
            if o is None:
                warnings.append(f"{label}: src_at={ev['src_at']} outside segment {ev['seg']!r} - dropped")
            return o
        return sp.out_start
    if "at" in ev:
        return float(ev["at"])
    if "src_at" in ev:
        o = src_to_out(spans, float(ev["src_at"]))
        if o is None:
            warnings.append(f"{label}: src_at={ev['src_at']} is in removed footage - dropped")
        return o
    raise EDLError(f"{label}: needs 'at' (output s) or 'src_at' (source s)")


def load(path: Path) -> dict:
    edl = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    validate(edl)
    return edl


def validate(edl: dict) -> None:
    if not edl.get("segments"):
        raise EDLError("EDL has no segments")
    for i, s in enumerate(edl["segments"]):
        t = s.get("type", "source")
        if t not in SEGMENT_TYPES:
            raise EDLError(f"segment {i}: type {t!r} not in {SEGMENT_TYPES}")
        if t == "source" and not (0 <= s["in"] < s["out"]):
            raise EDLError(f"segment {i}: need 0 <= in < out")
        if t == "cutaway" and "asset" not in s and "file" not in s:
            raise EDLError(f"segment {i}: cutaway needs 'asset' or 'file'")
        if t == "card" and not any(k in s for k in ("composition", "file", "motion", "template")):
            raise EDLError(f"segment {i}: card needs 'composition' or 'file'")
    for i, o in enumerate(edl.get("overlays", [])):
        if o.get("type") not in OVERLAY_TYPES:
            raise EDLError(f"overlay {i}: type {o.get('type')!r} not in {OVERLAY_TYPES}")


def collect_asset_ids(edl: dict) -> list[tuple[str, float | None]]:
    """(asset_id, approx time) for usage tracking."""
    out = []
    for s in edl["segments"]:
        if s.get("asset"):
            out.append((s["asset"], None))
    for group in (edl.get("overlays", []), edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []), edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", [])):
        for e in group:
            if e.get("asset"):
                out.append((e["asset"], e.get("at", e.get("src_at"))))
    return out
"""Pure-Python reader for Flashback (Moulberry) replay zips, MC 1.21.11 / protocol 774.

What it does
------------
Opens ``<replay>.zip`` (``metadata.json`` + ``c0.flashback`` ...), walks the action
stream *by its length prefixes* and decodes only what is needed to know where
everybody was and what happened:

* ``action/move_entities``      -> per-tick position/rotation of every entity (incl. the
                                   recording player). Full-fidelity, no Minecraft protocol needed.
* ``action/create_local_player``-> uuid / name / spawn pose of the recording player.
* ``action/accurate_player_position_optional`` -> sub-tick poses (only present when the
                                   recorder was configured with >20 local-player updates/s).
* a handful of ``action/game_packet`` payloads (by packet id, protocol 774): add/remove
  entity, player list, health, damage, death, respawn, chat, explosions, pickups, ...
  Everything else (chunks, lighting, inventory, ...) is skipped without decoding.
* ``metadata.json``             -> uuid, name, world, total ticks, markers, chunks.

Packet ids were read from the intermediary-mapped client jar
(``net.minecraft.class_9095.field_48173`` = ``GameProtocols.CLIENTBOUND_TEMPLATE``) and are
pinned to protocol 774; ``Replay.protocol_ok`` is False for other protocol versions and the
game-packet derived data should then be treated as unreliable (positions stay valid).

---
>>> r = load(path)                       # -> Replay
>>> r.total_ticks, r.local_name, r.players
>>> t = r.player_track()                 # local player Track (numpy, one row per tick)
>>> t.pos(tick) -> (x, y, z), t.yaw[tick], ...

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Data classes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@dataclass
class Marker:
    tick: int
    name: str
    colour: int = 0
    position: tuple | None = None  # (x, y, z)
    dimension: str | None = None


@dataclass
class Event:
    tick: int
    kind: str            # see Replay.EVENT_KINDS
    entity: str | None = None   # uuid (or "id:N")
    data: dict = field(default_factory=dict)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Event(t={self.tick}, {self.kind}, {self.data})"


@dataclass
class Track:
    """Per-tick pose of one entity, forward-filled between recorded updates."""

    key: str                       # uuid
    entity_id: int
    start: int                     # first tick covered
    x: np.ndarray
    y: np.ndarray
    z: np.ndarray
    yaw: np.ndarray                # degrees (Minecraft: 0=+Z/south, 90=-X/west)
    pitch: np.ndarray
    head_yaw: np.ndarray
    type: str = "?"
    name: str | None = None
    eye_height: float = 0.0

    @property
    def end(self) -> int:          # exclusive
        return self.start + len(self.x)

    def _i(self, tick: int) -> int:
        return min(max(tick - self.start, 0), len(self.x) - 1)

    def pos(self, tick: int):
        i = self._i(tick)
        return float(self.x[i]), float(self.y[i]), float(self.z[i])

    def eye(self, tick: int):
        x, y, z = self.pos(tick)
        return x, y + self.eye_height, z

    def rot(self, tick: int):
        i = self._i(tick)
        return float(self.yaw[i]), float(self.pitch[i])

    def speed(self, tick: int, window: int = 10) -> float:
        """Horizontal blocks/second averaged over +-window/2 ticks."""
        a = self._i(tick - window // 2)
        b = self._i(tick + window // 2)
        if b == a:
            return 0.0
        d = math.hypot(self.x[b] - self.x[a], self.z[b] - self.z[a])
        return d / ((b - a) / 20.0)

    def to_rows(self):
        for i in range(len(self.x)):
            yield (self.start + i, float(self.x[i]), float(self.y[i]), float(self.z[i]),
                   float(self.yaw[i]), float(self.pitch[i]), float(self.head_yaw[i]))

class Replay:
    EVENT_KINDS = (
        "death", "respawn", "damage", "heal", "hurt_anim", "dimension", "teleport", "chat",
        "system_chat", "explosion", "pickup", "kill", "mob_near", "player_join", "player_leave",

    # -- convenience --------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def duration_s(self) -> float:
        return self.total_ticks / 20.0

    def player_track(self, who: str | None = None) -> Track:
        """Track of the recording player (default) or of a player by name/uuid."""
        key = None
        if who is None:
            key = self.local_uuid
        elif who in self.tracks:
            key = who
        else:
            for u, n in self.players.items():
                if n.lower() == who.lower() and u in self.tracks:
                    key = u
                    break
        if key is None or key not in self.tracks:
            raise KeyError(f"no track for {who or 'local player'}")
        return self.tracks[key]

    def player_tracks(self) -> dict[str, Track]:
        """All player tracks, name -> Track."""
        return {self.players.get(k, k): t for k, t in self.tracks.items() if t.type == "player"}

    def entities_near(self, tick: int, center, radius: float, types=None):
        """[(Track, distance)] for non-local entities within ``radius`` blocks of ``center``."""
        out = []
        cx, cy, cz = center
        for k, t in self.tracks.items():
            if k == self.local_uuid or not (t.start <= tick < t.end):
                continue
            if types and t.type not in types:
                continue
            x, y, z = t.pos(tick)
            d = math.sqrt((x - cx) ** 2 + (y - cy) ** 2 + (z - cz) ** 2)
            if d <= radius:
                out.append((t, d))
        out.sort(key=lambda p: p[1])
        return out

    def events_of(self, *kinds: str):
        return [e for e in self.events if e.kind in kinds]

    def summary(self) -> str:
        lt = self.player_track() if self.local_uuid in self.tracks else None
        lines = [
            f"replay      : {self.path.name}  uuid={self.uuid}",
    def suggest_moments(self, min_gap_s: float = 8.0, top: int = 25):
        """Rank candidate B-roll windows. Returns dicts {tick, score, kind, reason, suggested_shot, pos}.

        Heuristic and deliberately simple; the scoring weights are the first thing to tune
        once real footage has been reviewed.
        """
        cands: list[dict] = []
        t = self.player_track()
        W = {"death": 10, "explosion": 6, "damage": 4, "kill": 5, "dimension": 6, "teleport": 4,
             "mob_near": 3, "pickup": 1.5, "respawn": 5, "lightning": 5}
        shot_for = {"death": "orbit", "explosion": "push_in", "damage": "orbit", "kill": "flyby",
                    "dimension": "drone_pullup", "teleport": "drone_pullup", "mob_near": "track_follow",
                    "pickup": "push_in", "respawn": "drone_pullup", "lightning": "drone_pullup"}
        for e in self.events:
            if e.kind in W:
                cands.append(dict(tick=e.tick, score=float(W[e.kind]), kind=e.kind,
                                  reason=f"{e.kind} {e.data}", suggested_shot=shot_for[e.kind]))
        # fast movement / big falls / climbs
        n = len(t.x)
        for i in range(0, n, 20):
            tick = t.start + i
            sp = t.speed(tick, 20)
            dy = float(t.y[min(i + 40, n - 1)] - t.y[i])
            if sp > 9.0:
                cands.append(dict(tick=tick, score=2.0 + min(sp - 9.0, 6.0) / 2, kind="fast_travel",
                                  reason=f"{sp:.1f} blocks/s", suggested_shot="flyby"))
            if dy < -12:
                cands.append(dict(tick=tick, score=3.0 + min(-dy / 20, 3.0), kind="fall",
                                  reason=f"fell {-dy:.0f} blocks", suggested_shot="drone_pullup"))
            elif dy > 12:
                cands.append(dict(tick=tick, score=2.0, kind="climb", reason=f"climbed {dy:.0f} blocks",
                                  suggested_shot="drone_pullup"))
        # other players close to us (collab moments)
        for k, tr in self.tracks.items():
            if k == self.local_uuid or tr.type != "player":
                continue
            for tick in range(max(t.start, tr.start), min(t.end, tr.end), 40):
                x, y, z = t.pos(tick)
                ox, oy, oz = tr.pos(tick)
                if math.dist((x, y, z), (ox, oy, oz)) < 8:
                    cands.append(dict(tick=tick, score=2.5, kind="player_near",
                                      reason=f"with {self.players.get(k, k)}", suggested_shot="orbit"))
        cands.sort(key=lambda c: -c["score"])
        out: list[dict] = []
        gap = int(min_gap_s * 20)
        for c in cands:
            if all(abs(c["tick"] - o["tick"]) >= gap for o in out):
                x, y, z = t.pos(c["tick"])
                c["pos"] = (round(x, 2), round(y, 2), round(z, 2))
                out.append(c)
            if len(out) >= top:
                break
        out.sort(key=lambda c: c["tick"])
        return out

"""mcs - Minecraft editing studio CLI.  Run `uv run mcs <command> -h` (from studio/) for details.

Assembly line:
  mcs new <slug> --game rec.mkv [--mic mic.wav]   create project
  mcs transcribe <slug>                           word-level transcript (source time)
  mcs analyze <slug>                              loudness/scene signals + frame sheets
  mcs scaffold <slug>                             first-pass edit.json (dead air removed)
  (planner edits edit.json: zooms, SFX, memes, greenscreens, text, bleeps, music)
  mcs check <slug>                                validate + timeline digest + policy warnings
  mcs render <slug> [--preview]                   ffmpeg render -> out/<slug>.mp4
Library:
  mcs assets find|show|stats                      query the editing-pack database
  mcs assets fav|unfav <ids...> / favs            star assets so the auto-editor prefers them
  mcs frames <slug> --from S --to E               frame sheet for a moment
  mcs ui                                          local web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8765
One click:
  mcs make <slug> --game rec.mkv [--mic m.wav] [--facecam cam.mp4] --title "..." --context "..."
  mcs auto <slug> [--final] [--shorts 3]          transcribe -> analyze -> autoplan -> render -> shorts
  mcs autoplan <slug> [--mode funny]              heuristic creative pass (no LLM needed)
  mcs engage <slug>                               add attention zooms to an existing edit
  mcs shorts <slug> [--count 3] [--render]        cut 9:16 shorts from the edit
  mcs autopilot run|once|status|enable|disable    watch OBS folders, edit every new recording by itself
Settings:
  mcs settings show [--slug S] [--changed]        feature switches (filters, SFX, memes, zooms, templates...)
  mcs settings set <section.key> <value> [--slug S]   e.g. looks.enabled off / motion.disabled_templates boss_bar
  mcs settings reset [section] [--slug S]
Libraries:
  mcs library add|scan|status                     your Stock Library (B-roll, stock, memes)
  mcs motion list|render <template> --var k=v     channel motion-graphics templates (HyperFrames)
  mcs avatar build|preview                        narrator avatar from brand/avatar/skin.png
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys


def cmd_assets(a):
    from . import assets as A
    if a.action == "stats":
        print(json.dumps(A.stats(), indent=2))
        return
    if a.action == "show":
        for i in a.ids:
            print(json.dumps(A.get(i), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        return
    if a.action in ("fav", "unfav"):
        if not a.ids:
            raise SystemExit(f"usage: mcs assets {a.action} <id> [<id> ...]")
        bad = 0
        for i in a.ids:
            try:
                d = A.set_favorite(i, a.action == "fav")
                print(f"{'*' if d['favorite'] else '-'} {d['id']}" + (f"  (redirected from {i})" if d["id"] != i else ""))
            except KeyError:
                print(f"unknown asset {i}", file=sys.stderr)
                bad += 1
        if bad:
            sys.exit(1)

# Comedy editing playbook (Minecraft)

These are the house rules for turning gameplay into a fast, funny edit. The numbers are defaults. Taste beats rules.

## Pacing

- **No dead air longer than ~0.6s** unless it's a deliberate awkward pause, and then *sell* the pause: crickets SFX, a slow zoom, a "..." text pop.
- A visual change every 2–5s: a cut, zoom, text, overlay, or angle change. Long building or mining stretches become **montages**: cut every 0.5–1s to the music beat, or run them at 2–4× speed with an "x4" label, or use a time-skip card.
- **Hook (first 8s):** the best moment or the most intriguing promise. Never open on "hey guys welcome back" unless it's cut very short and punched with an SFX.
- Give the video an arc: setup → escalation → payoff → button (a final joke, then cut to the outro fast).

## The beat → treatment map

| moment | go-to treatment |
|---|---|
| `emphasis` / punchline | snap zoom 1.3× (`in: 0.05`), vine boom or bass hit aligned to peak, optional 1-word text pop |
| `fail` | freeze_end 0.4–0.8s + zoom on the mistake, then sad trombone / bruh / "fail" stinger, maybe `bw` on the freeze |
| `death` | Minecraft death screen or "WASTED"/"YOU DIED" green screen, or a cutaway; heavy sting; music drops out |
| `jumpscare` | snap zoom 1.5–1.7× toward the mob + shake + scream SFX + flash; caption the yell in the `danger` style |
| `irony` (says "this is fine" before disaster) | hold on their line, hard cut to the disaster, then a "...or not" text / record scratch / "A FEW MOMENTS LATER" |
| `loot` | zoom on the item + sparkle/xp/advancement SFX + item sticker pop + "+1 DIAMOND" minecraft text |
| `victory` | epic advancement / MLG airhorn (sparingly) + confetti/rays overlay + music swell |
| `rage` | caption in caps with emphasis colours, shake, deep-fry for a big one, Tyler1-style clip only if rated OK |
| `awkward` | crickets, slow push-in, "..." or "bruh" sticker, staring meme cutaway |
| `confusion` | "huh?" SFX, confused-boy meme, question marks |
| `betrayal` | dramatic zoom on the betrayer, "Et tu" style text, dun dun dunnn |
| `time_skip` | SpongeBob time card cutaway or "X HOURS LATER" text + whoosh |
| `scene_change` | Minecraft item transition (wipe) + whoosh |
| `chase` / `panic` | speed-up 1.25×, intense music swap, running SFX, shaky cam |
| `censor` | bleep + mouth-cover sticker or blurred text pop |
| `cta` | Mid-video, at a natural lull. Use the pack's subscribe/Discord animations as overlay_corner, never during a joke. |

## SFX craft

- SFX lands **on** the visual event and **after** the spoken punchline, never on top of the words.
- `peak` alignment is for impacts, `onset` for voice lines and stingers.
- Variety: never the same meme SFX twice within 2 minutes. Utility sounds (whoosh, pop, click) can repeat freely.
- Layering: whoosh into the zoom + boom at the zoom's peak. Max 2 sounds stacked.
- Duck the music bed hard (or cut it with a fade) for big moments. Silence before a payoff makes it hit harder.

## Visual craft

- Keep the crosshair action visible. Put overlays in the corners (x 0.2/0.8, y 0.3/0.7) unless it's a deliberate full-screen gag.
- Zoom focus toward the subject. Snap-in with a smooth-out reads as a punch. Smooth-in with a snap-out reads as tension and release.
- Freeze frame + zoom + text = the classic "this is where it all went wrong".
- Green screen characters (Nice, thumbs up, laughing) work best entering from the frame edge (x≈0.8, y≈0.65, scale 0.5).
- Text pops: 1–3 words, ≤1.5s, and not more than one every ~4s, or they stop landing.

## Captions

- Always on, 1–3 words, current word highlighted. Add the 1–3 most important words per minute to `emphasis_words`: item names, mob names, swear substitutes, the joke word.
- Hide captions during cutaways that have their own text or speech.
- Fix misheard Minecraft words in the transcript: "creeper", "Nether", "elytra", "enderman", "netherite" and friend names.

## Music

- One bed per mood section, swapped at mood changes with 1–2s overlapping fades. Sneaky/comedic for exploring, intense for fights/chases, sad piano for ironic tragedy (short).
- Bed level −20 dB under voice with ducking. Drop to silence for 0.5–1s before huge payoffs.

def load_json(p: Path, default=None):
    try:
        return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return default


class Planner:
    def __init__(self, slug: str, mode: str | None = None, cold_open: bool = True, seed: int = 1):
        self.slug = slug
        self.proj = project_dir(slug)
        self.pj = load_json(self.proj / "project.json", {})
        self.tr = load_json(self.proj / "work" / "transcript.json", {"segments": []})
        self.sig = load_json(self.proj / "work" / "signals.json", {})
        self.modes = load_json(STUDIO / "modes.json", {})
        self.brand = load_json(STUDIO / "brand" / "brand.json", {})
        ctx = f"{self.pj.get('title', '')} {self.pj.get('context', '')}".lower()
        self.base_mode = mode or ("narration" if "narrat" in ctx or "story" in ctx else
                                  "pov" if re.search(r"\bpov\b", ctx) else "funny")
        self.S = SET.load(slug)                              # [settings] feature switches
        if not SET.mode_ok(self.S, self.base_mode):
            self.base_mode = "funny"
        self.cold_open = cold_open and self.S["camera"]["cold_open"]
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.words = [w for s in self.tr["segments"] for w in s.get("words", [])]
        self.used: list[str] = []
        self.caption_hides: list[dict] = []
        self.uses: dict[str, int] = {}
        self.mg_used: dict[str, list] = {}
        self.warn: list[str] = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ assets
    def pick(self, moments, roles=None, categories=None, **kw) -> dict | None:
        # [settings] favourites-only + switched-off SFX types
        cats = categories or []
        sfxish = any(c.startswith("sfx") for c in cats)
        if sfxish or "music" in cats:
            kw.setdefault("favorites_only", self.S["audio"]["favorites_only"])
        if {"meme_video", "green_screen"} & set(cats):
            kw.setdefault("favorites_only", self.S["memes"]["favorites_only"])
        role_filter = sfxish and bool(self.S["audio"]["disabled_sfx_roles"])
        roles = [r for r in roles or [] if not role_filter or SET.role_ok(self.S, [r])]
        q = A.Query(moments=moments, roles=roles, categories=cats, project=self.slug,
                    exclude=self.used, limit=8 if role_filter else 4, seed=self.rng.randint(0, 10 ** 6), **kw)
        res = A.find(q)
        if role_filter:
            res = [r for r in res if SET.role_ok(self.S, r.get("roles"))][:4]
        if not res:
            return None
        choice = res[0] if len(res) == 1 or self.rng.random() < 0.6 else self.rng.choice(res[:3])
        self.uses[choice["id"]] = self.uses.get(choice["id"], 0) + 1
        if choice.get("frequency") != "signature" or self.uses[choice["id"]] >= 2:
            self.used.append(choice["id"])                   # signature sounds: at most twice per video
        return choice

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 1. beats
    def beats(self) -> list[dict]:
        out = []
        n = len(self.words)
        for i in range(n):
            window = " ".join(w["word"] for w in self.words[i:i + 6]).lower()
            window = re.sub(r"[^\w' ?!]", "", window)
            for rx, moment, score, tmpl in LEXICON:
                m = re.match(rf"\s*({rx})", window)
                if m:
                    span = len(m.group(1).split())
                    last = self.words[min(n - 1, i + span - 1)]
                    word = re.sub(r"[^\w']", "", self.words[i + span - 1]["word"] if i + span - 1 < n else "").upper()
                    out.append({"t": self.words[i]["start"], "end": last["end"], "moment": moment, "score": score,
                                "text": tmpl.replace("{W}", word.rstrip("S") if tmpl.startswith("+1") else word)
                                if tmpl else None, "phrase": m.group(1), "keyword": word.lower()})
                    break
        for p in self.sig.get("voice_peaks", []):           # loud moments with no keyword -> emphasis
            if not any(abs(b["t"] - p["t"]) < 1.5 for b in out) and p.get("above_baseline_db", 0) >= 18:
                out.append({"t": p["t"], "end": p["t"] + 0.4, "moment": "emphasis", "score": 2, "text": None,
                            "phrase": "", "keyword": ""})
        for d in self.sig.get("death_screens", []):
            out.append({"t": d["t"], "end": d["t"] + 0.5, "moment": "death", "score": 5, "text": None,
                        "phrase": "<death screen>", "keyword": "", "death_screen": True})
        # de-duplicate: one beat per 1.2 s, keep the strongest
        out.sort(key=lambda b: (b["t"], -b["score"]))
        kept: list[dict] = []
        for b in out:
            if kept and b["t"] - kept[-1]["t"] < 1.2:
                if b["score"] > kept[-1]["score"]:
                    kept[-1] = b
                continue
            kept.append(b)
        return kept

def broll_clips(proj: Path, pj: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """B-roll available for this episode: projects/<slug>/broll/*.mp4, plus (when the project knows the OBS session
    timestamp) Stock Library/Minecraft B-Roll/auto/<session>/. -> [{"file": abs path, "dur": seconds}]. [] if none."""
    from .paths import ROOT
    folders = [proj / "broll"]
    session = (pj or {}).get("session")
    if session:
        folders.append(ROOT / "Stock Library" / "Minecraft B-Roll" / "auto" / session)
    files = [f for d in folders if d.is_dir() for f in sorted(d.iterdir())
             if f.suffix.lower() in (".mp4", ".mov", ".mkv", ".webm") and not f.name.startswith("_")]
    if not files:
        return []
    import subprocess
    out = []
    for f in files:
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0",
                                str(f)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
            out.append({"file": str(f.resolve()), "dur": float(r.stdout.strip() or 0)})
        except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            continue
    return out


def place_broll(segs: list[dict], clips: list[dict], beats: list[dict], *, duration: float, per_min: float = 1.5,
                rng: random.Random | None = None, dur_of=None, min_s: float = 1.5, max_s: float = 3.0,
                min_gap_s: float = 15.0) -> list[dict]:
    """Insert 2-5 short muted b-roll cutaways BETWEEN source segments (never on top of speech, so nothing the creator
    says is covered). Slots, best first: an establishing shot before the first main segment; right after a loot / death /
    victory reaction beat; in the middle of a long calm stretch. `segs` is modified in place; returns the new segments.
    clips = [{"file": path, "dur": seconds}] - clips shorter than min_s are ignored. No clips -> no-op."""
    rng = rng or random.Random(1)
    dur_of = dur_of or seg_duration
    clips = [c for c in clips if c.get("dur", 0) >= min_s and c.get("file")]
    if not clips or not segs:
        return []
    budget = min(5, len(clips) if len(clips) < 2 else max(2, round(duration / 60 * max(per_min, 1.0) * 1.5)))
    budget = max(1, min(budget, 5))
    srcs = [i for i, s in enumerate(segs) if s.get("type", "source") == "source" and not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    if not srcs:
        return []
    slots: list[tuple[float, int, str]] = [(100.0, srcs[0] - 1, "intro")]      # (priority, insert-after index, kind)
    for i in srcs:
        s = segs[i]
        if s.get("speed", 1) != 1:
            continue
        inside = [b for b in beats if s["in"] - 0.2 <= b["t"] < s["out"] and b["score"] >= 3]
        react = [b for b in inside if b["moment"] in ("loot", "death", "victory") and s["out"] - b["end"] <= 2.0]
        if react:
            slots.append((50.0 + max(b["score"] for b in react), i, "reaction"))
        elif not inside and (s["out"] - s["in"]) >= 10.0 and i != srcs[0]:
            slots.append((10.0 + min(s["out"] - s["in"], 30.0) / 10.0, i, "calm"))
    # output time at each insertion point (after segment i)
    ends, t = [], 0.0
    for s in segs:
        t += dur_of(s)
        ends.append(t)
    chosen: list[tuple[int, str, float]] = []
    for pri, after, kind in sorted(slots, key=lambda x: -x[0]):
        at = ends[after] if after >= 0 else 0.0
        if kind != "intro" and at < 4.0:
            continue
        if any(abs(at - c[2]) < min_gap_s for c in chosen):
            continue
        chosen.append((after, kind, at))
        if len(chosen) >= budget:
            break
    pool = clips[:]
    rng.shuffle(pool)
    placed: list[dict] = []
    for n, (after, kind, _at) in enumerate(sorted(chosen, key=lambda c: -c[0])):    # insert back to front: indexes stay valid
        c = pool[n % len(pool)]
        length = round(min(c["dur"], rng.uniform(min_s + 0.3, max_s)), 2)
        placed.append({"id": f"broll-{n + 1}", "type": "cutaway", "file": c["file"], "in": 0.0, "out": length,
                       "mute": True, "broll": kind})
        segs.insert(after + 1, placed[-1])
    pos = {id(x): i for i, x in enumerate(segs)}
    for k, seg in enumerate(sorted(placed, key=lambda x: pos[id(x)])):            # number them in timeline order
        seg["id"] = f"broll-{k + 1}"
    return placed


def autoplan(slug: str, mode: str | None = None, cold_open: bool = True, seed: int = 1) -> Path:
    p = Planner(slug, mode, cold_open, seed)
    edl = p.plan()
    dest = p.proj / "edit.json"
    if dest.exists():
        hist = p.proj / "history"
        hist.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        from datetime import datetime
        dest.replace(hist / f"edit.{datetime.now():%Y%m%d-%H%M%S}.json")
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    n = lambda k: len(edl[k]) if k in edl else 0  # noqa: E731
    print(f"[autoplan] {len(edl['segments'])} segments, {len(edl['audio']['sfx'])} sfx, {n('text')} text pops, "
          f"{n('overlays')} overlays, {len(edl['audio']['music'])} music beds, base mode {edl['mode']}")
    return dest

def stage_clip(ctx: Ctx, path: Path, src_in: float, dur: float, fps: int) -> Path:
    """Cut an overlay clip's used window to a clean, video-only, constant-fps lossless file (cached).

    Feeding pack clips straight in with -ss/-t made ffmpeg 9 hang at the very end of the final pass for some
    files (24 fps clips with a non-zero start time, e.g. 'Patrick Stewart Epic Facepalm', the anime speed
    lines): every frame got written, the mp4 was never finalised. Pre-cut inputs avoid it, and the final pass
    gets cheaper. ProRes/alpha sources stay ProRes 4444 so their alpha survives."""
    import hashlib as _h
    st = path.stat()
    key = _h.sha1(f"{path}|{st.st_mtime_ns}|{st.st_size}|{src_in:.3f}|{dur:.3f}|{fps}".encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
    alpha = path.suffix.lower() == ".mov"
    out = ctx.work / "stage" / f"clip_{key}.{'mov' if alpha else 'mkv'}"
    if not out.exists():
        out.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        codec = ["-c:v", "prores_ks", "-profile:v", "4444", "-pix_fmt", "yuva444p10le"] if alpha \
            else ["-c:v", "ffv1", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p"]
        tmp = out.with_name(out.stem + ".tmp" + out.suffix)
        run_ff(["-ss", f"{src_in:.3f}", "-t", f"{dur:.3f}", "-i", path, "-an", "-sn", "-dn",
                "-vf", f"fps={fps},setpts=PTS-STARTPTS", *codec, tmp], ctx.work, ctx.log)
        os.replace(tmp, out)
    return out


def build_overlays(ctx: Ctx, spans) -> tuple[list[list], list[str], str, list[dict]]:
    W, H, FPS = ctx.W, ctx.H, ctx.FPS
    inputs, chains, overlay_audio = [], [], []
    cur = "[0:v]"
    for k, ev in enumerate(ctx.edl.get("overlays", [])):
        label = f"overlay[{k}] {ev.get('asset') or ev.get('file')}"
        at = resolve_time(ev, spans, ctx.warnings, label)
        if at is None:
            continue
        if ev.get("template"):
            ev = {**ev, "file": str(motion_file(ctx, ev)), "placement": ev.get("placement", "fullscreen"),
                  "key_mode": "alpha", "audio": False}
            ev.setdefault("dur", motion_duration(ev["template"], ev.get("vars")))
        a = ctx.asset(ev["asset"]) if ev.get("asset") else {}
        path = ctx.media_path(ev)
        typ = ev["type"]
        mode = ev.get("key_mode", a.get("key_mode"))
        if mode == "alpha" and path.suffix.lower() == ".webm":
            ctx.warnings.append(f"{label}: webm side-data alpha can't be decoded by this ffmpeg build; "
                                "convert once with `mcs prep-alpha` or use a ProRes/PNG version")
        src_in = ev.get("in", a.get("use_in") or 0.0)
        if typ == "image":
            dur = ev.get("dur", 1.2)
        else:
            dur = ev.get("dur") or ((ev.get("out") or a.get("use_out") or a.get("duration_s") or 2.0) - src_in)
        if typ == "transition":
            cover = ev.get("cover_s", dur / 2)
            at = max(0.0, at - cover)
        if typ == "image":
            # Looped-image *inputs* stall ffmpeg 9's scheduler once they hit EOF before the main stream,
            # so stills/GIFs come in through the movie= source filter instead (staged to a short
            # relative path to dodge filtergraph escaping of Windows paths).
            stage = ctx.work / "stage"
            stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            staged = stage / f"img{k:03d}{path.suffix.lower()}"
            if not staged.exists() or staged.stat().st_size != path.stat().st_size:
                shutil.copyfile(path, staged)
            src_pad = f"movie=stage/{staged.name}:loop=0,setpts=N/{FPS}/TB,trim=duration={dur:.3f},"
        else:
            n = len(inputs) + 1
            inputs.append(["-i", stage_clip(ctx, path, src_in, dur, FPS)])
            src_pad = f"[{n}:v]setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,"
        placement = ev.get("placement") or a.get("placement") or "overlay_center"
        if typ == "transition" or placement == "fullscreen":
            size = f"scale={W}:{H}"
            x, y = "0", "0"
        else:
            sc = ev.get("scale", 0.45 if typ != "image" else 0.3)
            hpx = int(H * sc) // 2 * 2
            if ev.get("anim", "pop" if typ == "image" else None) == "pop":
                size = f"scale=w=-2:h='trunc({hpx}*{POP}/2)*2':eval=frame"
            else:
                size = f"scale=-2:{hpx}"
            cx, cy = ev.get("x", 0.5), ev.get("y", 0.5)
            x = f"{W * cx:.1f}-overlay_w/2"
            y = f"{H * cy:.1f}-overlay_h/2"
        flip = ",hflip" if ev.get("flip") else ""
        rot = f",rotate={ev['rotate']}*PI/180:c=none:ow=rotw(iw):oh=roth(ih)" if ev.get("rotate") else ""
        kf = key_filter(mode, a.get("key_color") if ev.get("key_color") is None else ev["key_color"], ev)
        op = f",colorchannelmixer=aa={ev['opacity']}" if "opacity" in ev else ""
        chains.append(f"{src_pad}fps={FPS},{kf},{size}{flip}{rot}{op},"
                      f"setpts=PTS+{at:.4f}/TB[ov{k}]")
        nxt = f"[v{k}]"
        chains.append(f"{cur}[ov{k}]overlay=x='{x}':y='{y}':enable='between(t,{at:.4f},{at + dur:.4f})':"
                      f"eof_action=pass{nxt}")
        cur = nxt
        if typ != "image" and ev.get("audio", True) and a.get("has_audio", 1):
            vol = ctx.matched_db(a, ctx.style["audio"]["mix"]["overlay_rel_db"],
                                 ctx.style["audio"]["sfx_db"] + (a.get("volume_db") or 0)) + ev.get("volume_db", 0)
            overlay_audio.append({"path": path, "at": at, "in": src_in, "dur": dur, "vol": vol})
    cur = avatar_overlays(ctx, spans, cur, chains)
    wm = ctx.edl.get("watermark") or {}
    if wm.get("image"):                                  # channel logo bug, top-right, whole video
        src = next((c for c in (STUDIO / wm["image"], Path(wm["image"])) if c.is_file()), None)
        if src:
            stage = ctx.work / "stage"
            stage.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            staged = stage / f"wm{src.suffix.lower()}"
            shutil.copyfile(src, staged)
            hpx = int(H * wm.get("size", 0.085 if ctx.format != "vertical" else 0.05)) // 2 * 2
            # ONE still frame held by overlay's eof_action=repeat: an endless looped source deadlocks ffmpeg 9's
            # scheduler once the other (-t limited) overlay inputs hit EOF
            chains.append(f"movie=stage/{staged.name},format=rgba,scale=-2:{hpx},"
                          f"colorchannelmixer=aa={wm.get('opacity', 0.8)}[wm]")
            m = int(H * 0.025)

def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    if not ASSETS_DB.exists():
        raise SystemExit("assets.db missing - run: python studio/catalog/merge_catalog.py")
    con = sqlite3.connect(ASSETS_DB, timeout=60)
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    _ensure_favorite_column(con)
    return con


def _ensure_favorite_column(con: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """A DB built by an older merge_catalog.py has no `favorite` column: add it and fill it from favorites.json."""
    cols = {r[1] for r in con.execute("PRAGMA table_info(assets)")}
    if not cols or "favorite" in cols:
        return
    try:
        con.execute("ALTER TABLE assets ADD COLUMN favorite INT DEFAULT 0")
    except sqlite3.OperationalError:   # another process added it first
        return
    ids = sorted(_favorite_ids(con))
    if ids:
        con.execute(f"UPDATE assets SET favorite = 1 WHERE id IN ({','.join('?' * len(ids))})", ids)
    con.commit()

    terms = [t for t in "".join(c if c.isalnum() else " " for c in text).split() if t]
    if not terms:
        return {}
    q = " OR ".join(f'"{t}"' for t in terms)
    rows = con.execute("SELECT id, bm25(assets_fts) AS s FROM assets_fts WHERE assets_fts MATCH ?", (q,)).fetchall()
    if not rows:
        return {}
    best = min(r["s"] for r in rows)  # bm25: more negative = better
    return {r["id"]: (r["s"] / best) * 3.0 for r in rows}

        if len(best) >= min_count:
            gags[k + ("s" if any(re.sub(r"[^a-z]", "", w["word"].lower()) == k + "s" for w in words) else "")] = \

             and not re.search(r"EARLIER|LATER", t["text"], re.I)]      # cold-open segues mean nothing in a short

    from . import settings as SET                          # [settings] shorts.hook_banner / template switches
    use_hook = SET.template_ok(SET.load(slug), "hook_banner")
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"

    if use_hook:

    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone

    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e)

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)

import json
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from mcstudio import cinematic as C  # noqa: E402
from mcstudio.edl import validate  # noqa: E402

FB = C.FLASHBACK_DIR
MCPR = C.REPLAYMOD_DIR
SESSION = STUDIO / "testdata" / "session-1502"

SLUG = "cine-unit"
passed = []


def ok(name):
    passed.append(name)
    print(f"  ok  {name}")


def test_parsing():
    d = C.parse_obs_name("2026-10-06 13-51-50.mp4")
    assert (d.year, d.hour, d.minute, d.second) == (2026, 13, 51, 50)
    d = C.parse_obs_name("2026-10-10T14_25_31.zip")
    assert (d.month, d.hour, d.second) == (10, 14, 31)
    assert C.parse_obs_name("gameplay.mp4") is None
    assert C.parse_obs_name("2026-13-45 99-99-99.mp4") is None
    ok("filename / time parsing")


def test_real_replay_metadata():
    for z in sorted(FB.glob("*.zip")):
        w = C.replay_window(z)
        meta = json.loads(zipfile.ZipFile(z).read("metadata.json"))
        # name = SAVE time: the zip is written within a few seconds after it, never before
        assert 0 <= z.stat().st_mtime - w["end"] < 15, (z.name, z.stat().st_mtime - w["end"])
        assert abs(w["dur"] - meta["total_ticks"] / 20) < 1e-6 and abs((w["end"] - w["start"]) - w["dur"]) < 1e-6
    for z in sorted(MCPR.glob("*.mcpr")):
        w = C.replay_window(z)
        meta = json.loads(zipfile.ZipFile(z).read("metaData.json"))
        assert abs(w["start"] - meta["date"] / 1000) < 1e-6 and abs(w["dur"] - meta["duration"] / 1000) < 1e-6
        assert abs(z.stat().st_mtime - w["end"]) < 10, "mcpr end = file mtime"
        assert C.parse_obs_name(z.name).timestamp() - w["start"] <= 1.0, "filename = start second"
    # the two sessions pair up by overlap: Flashback #1 with Replay Mod #1, #2 with #2
    a1, a2 = (C.replay_window(p) for p in sorted(FB.glob("*.zip"))[:2])
    b1, b2 = (C.replay_window(p) for p in sorted(MCPR.glob("*.mcpr"))[:2])
    assert C.overlap_s(a1, b1) > 150 and C.overlap_s(a2, b2) > 150
    assert C.overlap_s(a1, b2) == 0 and C.overlap_s(a2, b1) == 0
    ok("real Flashback/Replay Mod metadata -> wall-clock windows, pairs overlap correctly")


def test_find_replay_and_sync_math():
    fbs = sorted(FB.glob("*.zip"))
    w = C.replay_window(fbs[0])
    vw = {"start": w["start"] + 12.0, "end": w["start"] + 72.0, "dur": 60.0, "how": "test"}
    r = C.find_replay("auto-dig", dirs=[FB], window=vw)
    assert r and Path(r["path"]) == fbs[0] and abs(r["overlap_s"] - 60) < 0.01
    s = C.estimate_sync(vw, w)
    assert abs(s["offset_s"] - 12.0) < 1e-6 and s["method"] == "timestamps"
    assert C.find_replay("auto-dig", dirs=[FB], window={"start": 1.0, "end": 50.0, "dur": 49.0}) is None
    if SESSION.exists():                        # the real recorded session: replay time at video t=0 ~ 23.4 s
        rw = C.replay_window(SESSION / "2026-10-10T15_04_22.zip")
        mw = C.replay_window(SESSION / "2026_10_10_15_02_10.mcpr")
        vstart = C.parse_obs_name(SESSION_VIDEO.name).timestamp() + 0.83   # OBS log: Recording Start 15:02:36.833
        assert abs((vstart - rw["start"]) - 23.4) < 0.15, vstart - rw["start"]
        assert abs((vstart - mw["start"]) - 26.1) < 0.2, vstart - mw["start"]
    ok("find_replay by overlap + timestamp offset math (incl. the real 15:02 session: 23.4 s / 26.1 s)")


def test_xcorr_synthetic():
    rep = C.synthetic_replay(200, seed=3)
    fps = 4.0
    ra = C.replay_activity(rep.player_track(), fps)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    for shift in (7.3, -4.5, 12.0):
        k0 = int(max(0, -shift) * fps)
        v = ra[int(round((k0 / fps + shift) * fps)):][:int(90 * fps)]
        v = np.abs(v + 2.0) * 3 + rng.normal(0, 0.6, len(v))          # video motion energy: scaled, positive, noisy
        res = C.xcorr_offset(v, ra, fps, prior_s=shift + 3.0, max_lag_s=15)   # wrong prior by 3 s
        est = res["offset_s"] - (k0 / fps if shift < 0 else 0)
        assert abs(res["offset_s"] - (shift + k0 / fps)) < 0.2 and res["confidence"] > 0.6, (shift, res)
        est = C.refine_sync(None, rep, {"offset_s": shift + 3.0, "method": "timestamps", "confidence": 0.3,
                                        "notes": "x"}, v_series=v) if shift > 0 else None
        if est:
            assert est["method"] == "motion-xcorr" and abs(est["offset_s"] - shift) < 0.2, est
    # unrelated series -> weak -> falls back to the timestamp estimate
    noise = rng.normal(0, 1, int(90 * fps))
    base = {"offset_s": 5.0, "method": "timestamps", "confidence": 0.3, "notes": "ts"}
    fb = C.refine_sync(None, rep, base, v_series=noise)
    assert fb["method"] == "timestamps" and fb["offset_s"] == 5.0 and "too weak" in fb["notes"], fb
    ok("xcorr recovers known synthetic shifts (+7.3, -4.5, +12 s); falls back on noise")


def test_real_session_sync():
    if not (SESSION_VIDEO.exists() and SESSION.exists()):
        print("  --  real session sync skipped (files missing)")
        return
    from mcstudio import flashback_replay as F
    rp = F.load(SESSION / "2026-10-10T15_04_22.zip")
    rw = C.replay_window(SESSION / "2026-10-10T15_04_22.zip")
    st = SESSION_VIDEO.stat()
    dur = C._probe_duration(SESSION_VIDEO)
    vstart = C.parse_obs_name(SESSION_VIDEO.name).timestamp()
    refined = st.st_mtime - dur
    assert abs(refined - vstart) < 2 and abs(refined - (vstart + 0.83)) < 0.3, "file end - duration ~ OBS start"
    vw = {"start": vstart, "end": vstart + dur, "dur": dur, "how": "OBS filename"}
    est = C.estimate_sync(vw, rw)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = C.refine_sync(SESSION_VIDEO, rp, est)
    print(f"      real-session xcorr: offset {res['offset_s']:.2f}s confidence {res['confidence']} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s); "
          f"timestamp-only {est['offset_s']:.2f}s")
    assert res["method"] == "motion-xcorr" and res["confidence"] >= 0.7
    assert abs(res["offset_s"] - 23.43) < 0.5, res
    ok("real OBS+Flashback session: motion-xcorr offset within 0.5 s of the OBS-log truth (23.43 s)")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ scratch project
def make_scratch(slug=SLUG):
    src = PROJECTS / "auto-dig"
    dst = PROJECTS / slug
    if dst.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(dst)
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True)
    pj = json.loads((src / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pj["slug"] = slug
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(pj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "signals.json", "levels.json"):
        shutil.copyfile(src / "work" / f, dst / "work" / f)
    edl = json.loads((src / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    edl["project"] = slug
    (dst / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return dst


def scratch_replay(total_s):
    """Synthetic replay whose events line up with the auto-dig timeline (video t + 10 s = replay t)."""
    ev = [C.SynthEvent(int((100 + 10) * 20), "dimension", {"dimension": "minecraft:the_nether"}),
          C.SynthEvent(int((90 + 10) * 20), "explosion", {}), C.SynthEvent(int((139.6 + 10) * 20), "death", {})]
    return C.synthetic_replay(total_s, seed=5, events=ev)


SYNC = {"offset_s": 10.0, "method": "timestamps", "confidence": 0.9, "notes": "synthetic test"}


def covered_by_punchline(ctx, a, z):
    return ctx.hits(a, z)


def test_director():
    dst = make_scratch()
    try:
        plan = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC, write=True)
        shots = plan["shots"]
        print("\n" + C.plan_table(plan) + "\n")
        assert shots, "no shots planned"
        S = C.cfg(C.SET.load(SLUG))
        ctx = C._Ctx(SLUG, S)
        total = ctx.total
        assert len(shots) <= max(1, round(S["max_shots_per_min"] * total / 60))
        for a, b in zip(shots, shots[1:]):
            assert b["video_t"] - (a["video_t"] + a["dur_s"]) >= S["min_gap_s"] - 1e-6, (a["id"], b["id"])
            assert a["kind"] != b["kind"], "same kind back to back"
        for s in shots:
            assert 2.5 <= s["dur_s"] <= 5.0, s
            assert ctx.out_time(s["video_t"]) is not None and ctx.out_time(s["video_t"]) >= 8.0, "inside the hook"
            assert not ctx.hits(s["video_t"], s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"]), (s["id"], ctx.hits(s["video_t"], s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"]))
            assert s["replay_tick"] == round((s["video_t"] + 10.0) * 20)
            assert s["status"] == "planned" and s["params"]["anchor"]["tick"] >= s["replay_tick"]
        # no shot on a punchline word / the death screen / beyond the recording
        for d in ctx.sig["death_screens"]:
            for s in shots:
                assert s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"] <= d["t"] + 0.01 or s["video_t"] >= d["end"], "shot on the death screen"
        for s in shots:
            for b in ctx.beats:
                if b["score"] >= 3 and not b.get("death_screen"):
                    assert not (s["video_t"] < b["end"] and s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"] > b["t"]), (s["id"], b)
        kinds = {s["kind"] for s in shots}
        assert "aerial_establish" in kinds, kinds
        dr = [s for s in shots if s["kind"] == "death_reveal"]
        assert dr and dr[0]["video_t"] + dr[0]["dur_s"] <= 140.0, "death reveal must end before the death screen"
        ok(f"director constraints hold ({len(shots)} shots: {', '.join(sorted(kinds))})")

        # settings: disable kinds / cap / pov off
        p2 = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC, write=False,
                          settings={"cinematic": {"disabled_kinds": ["aerial_establish", "death_reveal"], "pov_shots": False,
                                                  "max_shots_per_min": 1}})
        assert not ({s["kind"] for s in p2["shots"]} & {"aerial_establish", "death_reveal", "pov"})
        assert len(p2["shots"]) <= 2
        p3 = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC, write=False, settings={"cinematic": {"enabled": False}})
        assert p3["shots"] == []
        ok("settings: disabled kinds / pov off / per-minute cap / master switch")

        # a replay too short to cover the video drops shots outside it
        p4 = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(60), sync=SYNC, write=False)
        assert all(s["replay_tick"] + s["ticks"] <= 60 * 20 for s in p4["shots"])
        ok("shots outside the replay are skipped")

        # jobs
        jobs = C.queue_jobs(SLUG, plan, replay=scratch_replay(260))
        assert len(jobs) == len(shots)
        for jp in jobs:
            j = json.loads(jp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for k in ("job_id", "shot_id", "kind", "replay", "tick_start", "tick_end", "ticks", "camera", "visuals", "export"):
                assert k in j, k
            e = j["export"]
            assert (e["width"], e["height"], e["codec"]) == (1920, 1080, "h264")
            assert e["fps"] == (60 if j["kind"] == "pov" else 30) and e["output"].startswith("broll/shot-")
            assert j["visuals"]["hide_gui"] and j["visuals"]["hide_nametags"] and j["visuals"]["hide_chat"]
            assert j["tick_end"] - j["tick_start"] >= j["ticks"]
        ok("job JSON valid (1920x1080 h264, fps 30/60, visual overrides)")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(PROJECTS / SLUG, ignore_errors=True)
        shutil.rmtree(C.job_dir(SLUG), ignore_errors=True)


def test_qa():
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cine_qa_"))
    try:
        exp = C.FakeExporter()

        def job(defect, kind="orbit", fps=30, dur=3.0):
            out = tmp / f"{defect or 'good'}.mp4"
            return {"project": "qa", "shot_id": "shot-qa", "kind": kind, "tick_start": 100, "dur_s": dur, "fake_defect": defect,
                    "export": {"width": 1920, "height": 1080, "fps": fps, "output_abs": str(out)}}, out
        j, out = job(None)
        exp.render(j)
        good = C.qa_clip(out, {"w": 1920, "h": 1080, "fps": 30, "dur": 3.0})
        assert good["ok"], good
        for defect, needle in (("black", "dark"), ("static", "static"), ("uniform", "block")):
            j, out = job(defect)
            exp.render(j)
            r = C.qa_clip(out, {"w": 1920, "h": 1080, "fps": 30, "dur": 3.0})
            assert not r["ok"] and any(needle in x for x in r["reasons"]), (defect, r)
            if defect == "black":
                assert any("night vision" in n for n in r["notes"])
        # night footage: a dim-but-real clip passes when the creator's own footage is dark too
        dim = tmp / "dim.mp4"
        C._ff(["-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc2=s=1920x1080:r=30:d=3", "-vf", "eq=brightness=-0.35,format=yuv420p", "-an", dim])
        lum = C.qa_clip(dim)["metrics"]["luma_mean"]
        assert C.qa_clip(dim, ref_luma=lum + 5)["ok"] or lum >= 25
        # wrong size / fps / duration
        j, out = job(None, fps=30, dur=3.0)
        r = C.qa_clip(out, {"w": 1280, "h": 720, "fps": 60, "dur": 5.0})
        assert not r["ok"] and len(r["reasons"]) == 3, r
        # blurry / flat-but-lit frame
        blur = tmp / "blur.mp4"
        C._ff(["-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc2=s=1920x1080:r=30:d=3", "-vf", "boxblur=60:5,format=yuv420p", "-an", blur])
        rb = C.qa_clip(blur)
        assert not rb["ok"], rb
        assert not C.qa_clip(tmp / "missing.mp4")["ok"]
        ok("QA: good passes; black / static / uniform-block / blur / wrong format rejected with reasons")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)


def test_splice_and_exporters():
    dst = make_scratch()
    try:
        C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC)
        C.queue_jobs(SLUG, replay=scratch_replay(260))
        # manual exporter: writes a checklist and waits
        c = C.render_queue(SLUG, "manual", force=True)
        assert c["waiting"] > 0 and (C.job_dir(SLUG) / "CHECKLIST.md").exists()
        # stub raises a pointer
        c = C.render_queue(SLUG, "flashback_auto", force=True)
        assert c["failed"] > 0
        shots = C.load_shots(SLUG)["shots"]
        assert "flashback-automation.md" in shots[0]["note"]
        C.queue_jobs(SLUG)
        c = C.render_queue(SLUG, "fake", force=True)
        assert c["rendered"] == len(shots) and c["rejected"] == 0, c
        edl = json.loads((dst / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        new, rep = C.splice(edl, SLUG)
        assert rep["added"], rep
        validate(new)
        ov = [o for o in new["overlays"] if o.get("cinematic")]
        assert len(ov) == len(rep["added"])
        for o in ov:
            assert o["type"] == "video" and o["placement"] == "fullscreen" and o["audio"] is False and o["dur"] >= 2.5
            assert o["seg"] and o["file"].startswith("broll/")
        assert new["overlays"][: len(ov)] == ov, "cinematic overlays sit under stickers/motion graphics"
        assert len(new["audio"]["sfx"]) >= len(edl["audio"]["sfx"])
        assert len(new["segments"]) == len(edl["segments"]), "must not extend the video"
        # idempotent + pure
        again, _ = C.splice(new, SLUG)
        assert len([o for o in again["overlays"] if o.get("cinematic")]) == len(ov)
        assert [o for o in edl["overlays"] if o.get("cinematic")] == []
        # a rejected shot is not spliced
        pl = C.load_shots(SLUG)
        pl["shots"][0]["status"] = "rejected"
        C._write(C.shots_path(SLUG), pl)
        n2, r2 = C.splice(edl, SLUG)
        assert len(r2["added"]) <= len(rep["added"]) - 1 or not rep["added"][0]["id"] == pl["shots"][0]["id"]
        # settings off -> unchanged
        off, r3 = C.splice(edl, SLUG, {"cinematic": {"enabled": False}})
        assert off is edl and not r3["added"]
        # no shots file -> unchanged
        shutil.rmtree(dst / "broll")
        same, _ = C.splice(edl, SLUG)
        assert same is edl
        ok("splice: valid edl, fullscreen muted overlays, idempotent, respects rejected/disabled, no shots -> unchanged")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(PROJECTS / SLUG, ignore_errors=True)
        shutil.rmtree(C.job_dir(SLUG), ignore_errors=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print("cinematic tests")
    test_parsing()
    test_real_replay_metadata()
    test_find_replay_and_sync_math()
    test_xcorr_synthetic()
    test_director()
    test_qa()
    test_splice_and_exporters()
    test_real_session_sync()
    print(f"\nall {len(passed)} cinematic tests passed")

def test_find_replay_and_sync_math():
    fbs = sorted(FB.glob("*.zip"))
    w = C.replay_window(fbs[0])
    vw = {"start": w["start"] + 12.0, "end": w["start"] + 72.0, "dur": 60.0, "how": "test"}
    r = C.find_replay("auto-dig", dirs=[FB], window=vw)
    assert r and Path(r["path"]) == fbs[0] and abs(r["overlap_s"] - 60) < 0.01
    s = C.estimate_sync(vw, w)
    assert abs(s["offset_s"] - 12.0) < 1e-6 and s["method"] == "timestamps"
    assert C.find_replay("auto-dig", dirs=[FB], window={"start": 1.0, "end": 50.0, "dur": 49.0}) is None
    if SESSION.exists():                        # the real recorded session: replay time at video t=0 ~ 23.4 s

        mw = C.replay_window(SESSION / "2026_10_10_15_02_10.mcpr")

def test_xcorr_synthetic():
    rep = C.synthetic_replay(200, seed=3)
    fps = 4.0
    ra = C.replay_activity(rep.player_track(), fps)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    for shift in (7.3, -4.5, 12.0):
        k0 = int(max(0, -shift) * fps)
        v = ra[int(round((k0 / fps + shift) * fps)):][:int(90 * fps)]
        v = np.abs(v + 2.0) * 3 + rng.normal(0, 0.6, len(v))          # video motion energy: scaled, positive, noisy
        res = C.xcorr_offset(v, ra, fps, prior_s=shift + 3.0, max_lag_s=15)   # wrong prior by 3 s
        est = res["offset_s"] - (k0 / fps if shift < 0 else 0)
        assert abs(res["offset_s"] - (shift + k0 / fps)) < 0.2 and res["confidence"] > 0.6, (shift, res)
        est = C.refine_sync(None, rep, {"offset_s": shift + 3.0, "method": "timestamps", "confidence": 0.3,
                                        "notes": "x"}, v_series=v) if shift > 0 else None
        if est:
            assert est["method"] == "motion-xcorr" and abs(est["offset_s"] - shift) < 0.2, est
    # unrelated series -> weak -> falls back to the timestamp estimate
    noise = rng.normal(0, 1, int(90 * fps))
    base = {"offset_s": 5.0, "method": "timestamps", "confidence": 0.3, "notes": "ts"}
    fb = C.refine_sync(None, rep, base, v_series=noise)
    assert fb["method"] == "timestamps" and fb["offset_s"] == 5.0 and "too weak" in fb["notes"], fb
    ok("xcorr recovers known synthetic shifts (+7.3, -4.5, +12 s); falls back on noise")


def test_real_session_sync():
    if not (SESSION_VIDEO.exists() and SESSION.exists()):
        print("  --  real session sync skipped (files missing)")
        return
    from mcstudio import flashback_replay as F
    rp = F.load(SESSION / "2026-10-10T15_04_22.zip")
    rw = C.replay_window(SESSION / "2026-10-10T15_04_22.zip")
    st = SESSION_VIDEO.stat()
    dur = C._probe_duration(SESSION_VIDEO)
    vstart = C.parse_obs_name(SESSION_VIDEO.name).timestamp()
    refined = st.st_mtime - dur
    assert abs(refined - vstart) < 2 and abs(refined - (vstart + 0.83)) < 0.3, "file end - duration ~ OBS start"
    vw = {"start": vstart, "end": vstart + dur, "dur": dur, "how": "OBS filename"}
    est = C.estimate_sync(vw, rw)
    t0 = time.time()
    res = C.refine_sync(SESSION_VIDEO, rp, est)
    print(f"      real-session xcorr: offset {res['offset_s']:.2f}s confidence {res['confidence']} ({time.time() - t0:.0f}s); "
          f"timestamp-only {est['offset_s']:.2f}s")
    assert res["method"] == "motion-xcorr" and res["confidence"] >= 0.7
    assert abs(res["offset_s"] - 23.43) < 0.5, res
    ok("real OBS+Flashback session: motion-xcorr offset within 0.5 s of the OBS-log truth (23.43 s)")

def make_scratch(slug=SLUG):
    src = PROJECTS / "auto-dig"
    dst = PROJECTS / slug
    if dst.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(dst)
    (dst / "work").mkdir(parents=True)
    pj = json.loads((src / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pj["slug"] = slug
    (dst / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(pj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for f in ("transcript.json", "signals.json", "levels.json"):
        shutil.copyfile(src / "work" / f, dst / "work" / f)
    edl = json.loads((src / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    edl["project"] = slug
    (dst / "edit.json").write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return dst


def scratch_replay(total_s):
    """Synthetic replay whose events line up with the auto-dig timeline (video t + 10 s = replay t)."""
    ev = [C.SynthEvent(int((100 + 10) * 20), "dimension", {"dimension": "minecraft:the_nether"}),
          C.SynthEvent(int((90 + 10) * 20), "explosion", {}), C.SynthEvent(int((139.6 + 10) * 20), "death", {})]
    return C.synthetic_replay(total_s, seed=5, events=ev)


SYNC = {"offset_s": 10.0, "method": "timestamps", "confidence": 0.9, "notes": "synthetic test"}


def covered_by_punchline(ctx, a, z):
    return ctx.hits(a, z)


def test_director():
    dst = make_scratch()
    try:
        plan = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC, write=True)
        shots = plan["shots"]
        print("\n" + C.plan_table(plan) + "\n")
        assert shots, "no shots planned"
        S = C.cfg(C.SET.load(SLUG))
        ctx = C._Ctx(SLUG, S)
        total = ctx.total
        assert len(shots) <= max(1, round(S["max_shots_per_min"] * total / 60))
        for a, b in zip(shots, shots[1:]):
            assert b["video_t"] - (a["video_t"] + a["dur_s"]) >= S["min_gap_s"] - 1e-6, (a["id"], b["id"])
            assert a["kind"] != b["kind"], "same kind back to back"
        for s in shots:
            assert 2.5 <= s["dur_s"] <= 5.0, s
            assert ctx.out_time(s["video_t"]) is not None and ctx.out_time(s["video_t"]) >= 8.0, "inside the hook"
            assert not ctx.hits(s["video_t"], s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"]), (s["id"], ctx.hits(s["video_t"], s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"]))
            assert s["replay_tick"] == round((s["video_t"] + 10.0) * 20)
            assert s["status"] == "planned" and s["params"]["anchor"]["tick"] >= s["replay_tick"]
        # no shot on a punchline word / the death screen / beyond the recording
        for d in ctx.sig["death_screens"]:
            for s in shots:
                assert s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"] <= d["t"] + 0.01 or s["video_t"] >= d["end"], "shot on the death screen"
        for s in shots:
            for b in ctx.beats:
                if b["score"] >= 3 and not b.get("death_screen"):
                    assert not (s["video_t"] < b["end"] and s["video_t"] + s["dur_s"] > b["t"]), (s["id"], b)
        kinds = {s["kind"] for s in shots}
        assert "aerial_establish" in kinds, kinds
        dr = [s for s in shots if s["kind"] == "death_reveal"]
        assert dr and dr[0]["video_t"] + dr[0]["dur_s"] <= 140.0, "death reveal must end before the death screen"
        ok(f"director constraints hold ({len(shots)} shots: {', '.join(sorted(kinds))})")

        # settings: disable kinds / cap / pov off
        p2 = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC, write=False,
                          settings={"cinematic": {"disabled_kinds": ["aerial_establish", "death_reveal"], "pov_shots": False,
                                                  "max_shots_per_min": 1}})
        assert not ({s["kind"] for s in p2["shots"]} & {"aerial_establish", "death_reveal", "pov"})
        assert len(p2["shots"]) <= 2
        p3 = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(260), sync=SYNC, write=False, settings={"cinematic": {"enabled": False}})
        assert p3["shots"] == []
        ok("settings: disabled kinds / pov off / per-minute cap / master switch")

        # a replay too short to cover the video drops shots outside it
        p4 = C.plan_shots(SLUG, scratch_replay(60), sync=SYNC, write=False)
        assert all(s["replay_tick"] + s["ticks"] <= 60 * 20 for s in p4["shots"])
        ok("shots outside the replay are skipped")

        # jobs
        jobs = C.queue_jobs(SLUG, plan, replay=scratch_replay(260))
        assert len(jobs) == len(shots)
        for jp in jobs:
            j = json.loads(jp.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            for k in ("job_id", "shot_id", "kind", "replay", "tick_start", "tick_end", "ticks", "camera", "visuals", "export"):
                assert k in j, k
            e = j["export"]
            assert (e["width"], e["height"], e["codec"]) == (1920, 1080, "h264")
            assert e["fps"] == (60 if j["kind"] == "pov" else 30) and e["output"].startswith("broll/shot-")
            assert j["visuals"]["hide_gui"] and j["visuals"]["hide_nametags"] and j["visuals"]["hide_chat"]
            assert j["tick_end"] - j["tick_start"] >= j["ticks"]
        ok("job JSON valid (1920x1080 h264, fps 30/60, visual overrides)")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(PROJECTS / SLUG, ignore_errors=True)
        shutil.rmtree(C.job_dir(SLUG), ignore_errors=True)


def test_qa():
    tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="cine_qa_"))
    try:
        exp = C.FakeExporter()

        def job(defect, kind="orbit", fps=30, dur=3.0):
            out = tmp / f"{defect or 'good'}.mp4"
            return {"project": "qa", "shot_id": "shot-qa", "kind": kind, "tick_start": 100, "dur_s": dur, "fake_defect": defect,
                    "export": {"width": 1920, "height": 1080, "fps": fps, "output_abs": str(out)}}, out
        j, out = job(None)
        exp.render(j)
        good = C.qa_clip(out, {"w": 1920, "h": 1080, "fps": 30, "dur": 3.0})
        assert good["ok"], good
        for defect, needle in (("black", "dark"), ("static", "static"), ("uniform", "block")):
            j, out = job(defect)
            exp.render(j)
            r = C.qa_clip(out, {"w": 1920, "h": 1080, "fps": 30, "dur": 3.0})
            assert not r["ok"] and any(needle in x for x in r["reasons"]), (defect, r)
            if defect == "black":
                assert any("night vision" in n for n in r["notes"])
        # night footage: a dim-but-real clip passes when the creator's own footage is dark too
        dim = tmp / "dim.mp4"
        C._ff(["-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc2=s=1920x1080:r=30:d=3", "-vf", "eq=brightness=-0.35,format=yuv420p", "-an", dim])
        lum = C.qa_clip(dim)["metrics"]["luma_mean"]
        assert C.qa_clip(dim, ref_luma=lum + 5)["ok"] or lum >= 25
        # wrong size / fps / duration
        j, out = job(None, fps=30, dur=3.0)
        r = C.qa_clip(out, {"w": 1280, "h": 720, "fps": 60, "dur": 5.0})
        assert not r["ok"] and len(r["reasons"]) == 3, r
        # blurry / flat-but-lit frame
        blur = tmp / "blur.mp4"
        C._ff(["-f", "lavfi", "-i", "testsrc2=s=1920x1080:r=30:d=3", "-vf", "boxblur=60:5,format=yuv420p", "-an", blur])
        rb = C.qa_clip(blur)
        assert not rb["ok"], rb
        assert not C.qa_clip(tmp / "missing.mp4")["ok"]
        ok("QA: good passes; black / static / uniform-block / blur / wrong format rejected with reasons")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)

        C.queue_jobs(SLUG)

        assert c["rendered"] == len(shots) and c["rejected"] == 0, c
        edl = json.loads((dst / "edit.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        new, rep = C.splice(edl, SLUG)
        assert rep["added"], rep
        validate(new)
        ov = [o for o in new["overlays"] if o.get("cinematic")]
        assert len(ov) == len(rep["added"])
        for o in ov:
            assert o["type"] == "video" and o["placement"] == "fullscreen" and o["audio"] is False and o["dur"] >= 2.5
            assert o["seg"] and o["file"].startswith("broll/")
        assert new["overlays"][: len(ov)] == ov, "cinematic overlays sit under stickers/motion graphics"
        assert len(new["audio"]["sfx"]) >= len(edl["audio"]["sfx"])
        assert len(new["segments"]) == len(edl["segments"]), "must not extend the video"
        # idempotent + pure
        again, _ = C.splice(new, SLUG)
        assert len([o for o in again["overlays"] if o.get("cinematic")]) == len(ov)
        assert [o for o in edl["overlays"] if o.get("cinematic")] == []
        # a rejected shot is not spliced
        pl = C.load_shots(SLUG)

        C._write(C.shots_path(SLUG), pl)

        # settings off -> unchanged

        # no shots file -> unchanged

        same, _ = C.splice(edl, SLUG)
        assert same is edl
        ok("splice: valid edl, fullscreen muted overlays, idempotent, respects rejected/disabled, no shots -> unchanged")
    finally:

"""Generate Flashback (Moulberry) editor-state / keyframes for automatic cinematic B-roll.

Everything here mirrors what the decompiled mod (v0.39.10, MC 1.21.11) reads and writes:

* ``.minecraft/flashback/editor_states/<replay uuid>.json``  <- ``EditorState`` serialised with
  ``FlashbackGson.COMPRESSED`` (Gson). The file name is the ``uuid`` from the replay's metadata.json.
  ``Flashback.openReplayWorld`` calls ``EditorStateManager.get(uuid)`` which loads it, so writing this
  file *before* the replay is opened is how keyframes are injected without touching the GUI.
* Timeline unit = **replay ticks (20/s)**; keyframes live in ``scene.keyframeTracks[i].keyframesByTick``
  keyed by tick-as-string. One scene == one shot (own tracks + own export range).
* Camera conventions (verified from ``KeyframeChangeCameraPosition*`` / ``KeyframeChangeTrackEntity``):
    - ``camera`` keyframe ``position`` is the *feet* position of the camera entity; the eye is +1.62.
    - ``camera_orbit``: camera eye = center - look(yaw,pitch) * distance, facing (yaw,pitch).

    - MC angles: yaw 0 = +Z (south), 90 = -X (west); pitch +90 = straight down.

Public API
----------
Shot templates (all return a :class:`Shot`):  ``orbit``, ``drone_pullup``, ``push_in``, ``flyby``,
``track_follow``, ``timelapse``.   Build a document with :func:`build_state`, validate with
